verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (Virtual Mail) documents a REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and an official MCP server, but nothing in the evidence shows an official command-line tool. The API spec and MCP server are adjacent machine surfaces, not a CLI. An official CLI is a plausible offering for a SaaS service like this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
